purpose: Grounded inventory for map, screener, holdings, export and workspace-layout voice actions. This file is descriptive and does not register adapters.

states.source-verified: Implemented in the current repository with an explicit state assertion; still requires normal runtime verification after deployment.
states.candidate-disabled: A fail-closed adapter exists but is intentionally not registered pending live binding verification.
states.documented-unbound: Official Godel documentation describes the capability, but no exact callback or unique DOM binding is enabled.
states.live-observed-unbound: Seen in the authenticated terminal, but output semantics or binding remain unverified.
states.open-only: The CLI command may open the panel; no nested action is enabled.
